text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa arrives at summer camp and learns of a festival nearby where locals wear masks and dance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa can feel the spirit of the mascarada in the masks and dance of the event, causing her excitement for the event to grow further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Already taking a surprising turn, it looks like another passionate summer camp is in store for El Condor Pasa!
